sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州及全球各地合作创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这全都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%无形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: It's totally unfair.
sentences.zh: 这太不公平了。

sentences.en: Hydrox cookies came out in 1908.
sentences.zh: Hydrox 饼干于 1908 年问世。

sentences.en: Oreos didn't show up until four years later, but it didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 奥利奥直到四年后才出现，但这并不重要。

sentences.en: Hydrox could never shake the image of being a knockoff, and also ran.
sentences.zh: Hydrox 始终无法摆脱山寨货和陪跑者的形象。

sentences.en: Hydrox lovers would champion its Tangier cream filling.
sentences.zh: Hydrox 的爱好者会力挺它那丹吉尔奶油夹心。

sentences.en: Vegetarians would praise them for being cruelty-free, while America's favorite cookie, the Oreo, contained animal art until the mid-90s.
sentences.zh: 素食主义者会称赞它们不含动物成分，而美国人最喜欢的饼干奥利奥在 90 年代中期之前一直含有动物成分。

sentences.en: As a consumer product, it's just not up to you.
sentences.zh: 作为消费者产品，这根本由不得你。

sentences.en: Sometimes you're deemed the mighty Transformer, and sometimes you're the loathsome Go-Bot.
sentences.zh: 有时你被视为强大的变形金刚，有时你则是惹人厌的机器宝。

sentences.en: One shall stand, and one shall fall.
sentences.zh: 一个站着，一个倒下。

sentences.en: It's Capricious who wins.
sentences.zh: 谁赢谁输全凭反复无常。

sentences.en: Swiss Cake Roll vs. Ho-Ho.
sentences.zh: 瑞士蛋糕卷对决 Ho-Ho 蛋糕。

sentences.en: Twizzler vs. Red Vine.
sentences.zh: Twizzlers 扭扭糖对决红藤红甘草糖。

sentences.en: Maybe yours was the first family on the block with the technologically superior Betamax player,
sentences.zh: 也许你家是街区里第一批拥有技术上更先进的 Betamax 录像机的家庭，

sentences.en: only to be overwhelmed by the mediocre VHS tape.
sentences.zh: 结果却被平庸的 VHS 录像带给压倒了。

sentences.en: Sometimes it doesn't make any sense at all.
sentences.zh: 有时候这完全讲不通。

sentences.en: But sometimes it does.
sentences.zh: 但有时确实如此。

sentences.en: I'm John Lwallum.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·劳卢姆。

sentences.en: John is a writer for the New York Times Magazine and a writer at large for Pop-Up Magazine,
sentences.zh: 约翰是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人，也是《弹出式杂志》的特约作家，

sentences.en: the live magazine in San Francisco, where this story first appeared.
sentences.zh: 《弹出式杂志》是旧金山的一本现场杂志，这个故事最早就是在那上面发表的。

sentences.en: Right, so it's 1902, and Theodore Roosevelt is president.
sentences.zh: 对，那是 1902 年，西奥多·罗斯福是总统。

sentences.en: And he decides to vacation in a town called Smeeds in the Mississippi woods, where he can hunt black bear.
sentences.zh: 他决定去密西西比州树林里一个叫斯米兹的小镇度假，在那里他可以猎黑熊。

sentences.en: He's a big outdoorsman, big hunter.
sentences.zh: 他是个狂热的户外运动爱好者和大猎手。

sentences.en: And this hunting trip became kind of a famous story.
sentences.zh: 而这次狩猎之旅后来变成了一个著名的故事。

sentences.en: Basically, he had spent a few days hunting, and I don't think they even saw a single bear.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他花了几天时间打猎，而且我觉得他们连一头熊都没看到。

sentences.en: They definitely didn't get to shoot at any.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对没有机会对任何熊开枪。

sentences.en: And then one morning, the dogs get the scent of a bear, and they follow it down into this really weedy place
sentences.zh: 然后有一天早上，猎犬嗅到了一头熊的气味，它们一路追踪到这个杂草丛生的地方，

sentences.en: where the president's guide says,
sentences.zh: 总统的向导说道：

sentences.en: You know what, don't even bother going in there and troubling yourself.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，甚至不用费劲进去自找麻烦。

sentences.en: I'll go in, and I'll flush the bear out.
sentences.zh: 我进去把熊轰出来。

sentences.en: You just stay here, and I'll flush it right to you.
sentences.zh: 你就在这儿待着，我把它直接赶向你。

sentences.en: So Roosevelt waits and waits, but then he gets bored and decides to go off and eat lunch.
sentences.zh: 于是罗斯福等啊等，但接着他觉得无聊了，便决定离开去吃午饭。

sentences.en: Eventually, the dogs do corner the bear, and the guide, not really knowing what to do,
sentences.zh: 最终，猎犬确实把熊逼入了绝境，而向导不知道该怎么办，

sentences.en: leaps off his horse, cracks the bear over the head with the butt of his rifle,
sentences.zh: 便从马背上跳下来，用步枪枪托狠狠砸了一下熊的脑袋，

sentences.en: knocks it unconscious or semi-unconscious, and ties it to a tree.
sentences.zh: 把它打得失去知觉或半失去知觉，然后把它绑在一棵树上。

sentences.en: And then starts blowing away on his bugle, trying to call Roosevelt back so that the president can be
sentences.zh: 接着他开始狂吹军号，试图把罗斯福叫回来，好让总统

sentences.en: the one who has the honor of shooting it.
sentences.zh: 成为有获此殊荣开枪击毙它的人。

sentences.en: Roosevelt hears the bugle and makes his way back to the hunting party.
sentences.zh: 罗斯福听到军号声，便赶回了狩猎队。,

sentences.en: And what he finds is this bear.
sentences.zh: 而他看到的是这样一头熊。

sentences.en: It's a female bear.
sentences.zh: 这是一头母熊。

sentences.en: It weighs about 235 pounds, and it's tied to a tree.
sentences.zh: 它重约 235 磅，被绑在树上。

sentences.en: It's still semi-conscious.
sentences.zh: 它仍然处于半清醒状态。

sentences.en: It's injured.
sentences.zh: 它受伤了。

sentences.en: It looks a little mangy.
sentences.zh: 它看起来有点疥疮缠身、肮脏瘦弱。

sentences.en: It's actually probably about half as heavy and big as it should be, but there's been a real drought going on in the area.
sentences.zh: 实际上它可能只有应有体重和体型的一半左右，但当时该地区正经历一场真正的干旱。

sentences.en: The bear looks pathetic, and Roosevelt takes pity on it.
sentences.zh: 这头熊看起来很可怜，罗斯福对它动了恻隐之心。

sentences.en: He decides that it's unsportsmanlike to shoot this thing.
sentences.zh: 他决定枪杀这东西有失体育道德。

sentences.en: You know, he's not going to do it, and he doesn't want anyone else to do it either.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他不打算这么做，他也不希望别人这么做。

sentences.en: So he lowers his gun, and in this sort of merciful moment,
sentences.zh: 于是他放下枪，在这个充满仁慈的时刻，

sentences.en: word of this spreads, and a political cartoonist draws a cartoon of the moment of him showing the bear this mercy.
sentences.zh: 这个消息传开了，一位政治漫画家画了一幅漫画，描绘了他对这头熊展现仁慈的时刻。

sentences.en: And the way the cartoonist draws the bear is almost like a little Labrador puppy or a golden retriever puppy.
sentences.zh: 漫画家把这头熊画得几乎就像一只拉布拉多幼犬或金毛寻回犬幼犬。

sentences.en: It's sort of on its butt and its hind legs, and it's got these big, round, perked-up ears,
sentences.zh: 它有点坐在屁股和后腿上，长着又大又圆、竖起来的耳朵，

sentences.en: almost like Mickey Mouse, and these big, wide eyes.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像米老鼠一样，还有又大又圆的眼睛。

sentences.en: And it's staring at the president, waiting to see what its fate will be.
sentences.zh: 它盯着总统，等待着自己的命运将会如何。

sentences.en: The cartoon was called Drawing the Line in Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 这幅漫画被称为《在密西西比划清界限》。

sentences.en: And from that basically spawned the teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 泰迪熊基本上就是从这诞生的。

sentences.en: This adorable little bear in the cartoon was turned into a three-dimensional plush toy.
sentences.zh: 漫画中这只可爱的小熊被变成了一个三维毛绒玩具。

sentences.en: The very first teddy bear was either made by a German company called Stief,
sentences.zh: 第一只泰迪熊要么是由一家名为史泰福的德国公司制作的，

sentences.en: or a Brooklyn toy store owner, depending on who you ask.
sentences.zh: 要么是由布鲁克林的一家玩具店老板制作的，具体取决于你问谁。

sentences.en: And they name it after Theodore Roosevelt.
sentences.zh: 人们以西奥多·罗斯福的名字给它命名。

sentences.en: They call it Teddy's Bear.
sentences.zh: 他们叫它“泰迪的熊”。

sentences.en: It's a huge sensation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的轰动。

sentences.en: And it's actually more popular than baby dolls, which freaks everyone out a little bit.
sentences.zh: 它实际上比婴儿娃娃更受欢迎，这让每个人都感到有点惊恐。

sentences.en: You know, why should their children be playing with bears and not dolls?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，为什么他们的孩子应该玩熊而不是娃娃？

sentences.en: It's a little savage.
sentences.zh: 这有点野蛮。

sentences.en: And within a few years, I think Stief is producing close to a million teddy bears a year
sentences.zh: 在几年内，我想史泰福每年生产近百万只泰迪熊，

sentences.en: and shipping them to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并将它们运往美国。

sentences.en: But it was considered so bizarre that kids would play with a stuffed bear
sentences.zh: 但孩子们玩毛绒熊被认为太怪异了，

sentences.en: that people just assumed it was a novelty.
sentences.zh: 以至于人们只是认为这是一种新鲜玩意儿。

sentences.en: And as soon as Roosevelt left office, no one would want them anymore.
sentences.zh: 一旦罗斯福卸任，就不会有人再想要它们了。

sentences.en: And at this time, the whole idea of mass-produced toys was also really new.
sentences.zh: 而在当时，大规模生产玩具的概念也真的非常新颖。

sentences.en: So the toy industry wanted to kind of capitalize on its rally and keep it going.
sentences.zh: 所以玩具行业想要利用这股热潮并将其延续下去。

sentences.en: So it was really looking for whatever was going to be the next cuddly plaything
sentences.zh: 因此，它一直在寻找将会成为美国孩子们下一个想要拥有的可爱玩伴的东西，尽管它不知道那会是什么。

sentences.en: that American kids were going to want, although it had no idea what that might be.
sentences.zh: 所以时间快进到 1909 年。

sentences.en: So fast forward to 1909.
sentences.zh: 罗斯福的任期即将结束，当选总统是罗斯福亲自挑选的继任者，

sentences.en: And Roosevelt's term is about up, and the president-elect is Roosevelt's hand-picked successor,
sentences.zh: 威廉·霍华德·塔夫茨（William Howard Taft）。

sentences.en: William Howard Taft.
sentences.zh: 当年一月，即 1909 年 1 月，塔夫特在亚特兰大。

sentences.en: And that January, January 1909, Taft is in Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 他试图拉拢南方，试图让他们相信他的政府将把他们作为选民群体来看待。

sentences.en: He's trying to woo the South, try to convince him that his administration is going to take them
sentences.zh: 他是这场宴会上的主宾。

sentences.en: seriously as a constituency.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大商会决定为他提供最地道、最朴实无华的南方菜肴。

sentences.en: And he's the guest of honor at this banquet.
sentences.zh: 这是当时的某位作家——我找到了这本关于当时南方食物的小册子——

sentences.en: And the Chamber of Commerce in Atlanta decides it's going to serve him the truest,
sentences.zh: 称之为“伊壁鸠鲁式黑人的圣诞鹅”的东西。

sentences.en: most unpretentious Southern dish around.
sentences.zh: 这顿饭是负鼠配土豆。

sentences.en: It's something that a writer of the time, I found this little book about Southern food
sentences.zh: 具体做法是将负鼠放在甜薯床上烤熟，

sentences.en: from the time, calls it the Christmas goose of the Epicurean Negro.
sentences.zh: 然后连头带尾整只摆在盘子里端上来。

sentences.en: The meal was possum and taters.
sentences.zh: 通常你还会在动物的牙齿间塞进一个更小的小红薯。

sentences.en: And what it was was a possum would be roasted on a bed of sweet potatoes
sentences.zh: 50 颗牙齿。

sentences.en: and then presented whole on a platter with its head on, its tail on.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，50 颗牙齿显然是所有北美哺乳动物中牙齿最多的。

sentences.en: And often you'd get a smaller, little sweet potato crammed between the animal's teeth.
sentences.zh: 这太迷人了。

sentences.en: 50 teeth.
sentences.zh: 最后，送到塔夫特餐桌上的那只重达 18 磅。

sentences.en: By the way, 50 teeth is apparently the most teeth of any North American mammal.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，乐队奏起音乐，客人们齐声高歌。

sentences.en: Which is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 忽然，塔夫特收到了一份惊喜礼物。

sentences.en: In the end, the one that they brought to Taft's table weighed 18 pounds.
sentences.zh: 那是一个小型的毛绒负鼠玩具。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, the orchestra strikes up and the guests burst into song.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全新的发明，当地的一些塔夫特支持者正试图将它定位为

sentences.en: Suddenly, Taft is presented with this surprise gift.
sentences.zh: 威廉·塔夫特总统对泰迪熊的回应。

sentences.en: And it's a small, stuffed opossum toy.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为比利负鼠（Billy Possum）。

sentences.en: And this is a brand new invention that some local Taft supporters are trying to position
sentences.zh: 当时已经成立了一家名为佐治亚比利负鼠公司的企业。

sentences.en: as William Taft's presidency's answer to the teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 据一位记者的说法，在那场宴会后的小时内，

sentences.en: They're calling it the Billy Possum.
sentences.zh: 就已经有全国各地的经销商在商谈比利负鼠的交易了。

sentences.en: Already, there was a company set up called the Georgia Billy Possum Company.
sentences.zh: 《洛杉矶时报》在报道这场宴会时宣布，

sentences.en: According to one account, within 24 hours of that banquet,
sentences.zh: 泰迪熊已经被挤到了后排座位上。

sentences.en: there were already deals being brokered for Billy Possums with distributors across the country.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的四年里，甚至可能是八年里，

sentences.en: In covering the banquet, the LA Times announced that
sentences.zh: 全美国的儿童都将玩比利负鼠。

sentences.en: the teddy bear has been relegated to a seat in the rear.
sentences.zh: 因此从那时起，一股负鼠狂热开始了。

sentences.en: And for four years, possibly eight,
sentences.zh: 有比利负鼠明信片，

sentences.en: the children of the United States will play with Billy PossuMs.
sentences.zh: 比利负鼠徽章，

sentences.en: So from then on, a bit of possum mania started.
sentences.zh: 喝咖啡时搅拌奶油用的比利负鼠图片。

sentences.en: There were Billy Possum postcards,
sentences.zh: 还有一首名为《负鼠，最新风潮》的拉格泰姆曲子。

sentences.en: Billy Possum pins,
sentences.zh: 随着塔夫特在南方各地旅行，

sentences.en: Billy Possum pictures for your cream when you had coffee.
sentences.zh: 当他公开露面时，有些人实际上开始送给他关在笼子里的活负鼠，

sentences.en: There was a ragtime tune called Possum, The Latest Craze.
sentences.zh: 有点像送花束那样把它们递过来。

sentences.en: And as Taft traveled around the South,
sentences.zh: 很快，从纽约到旧金山的玩具店里到处都是比利负鼠。

sentences.en: some people actually started giving him live opossums in cages
sentences.zh: 因为当时真正的负鼠在城市里并不那么常见，

sentences.en: when he would make public appearances,
sentences.zh: 而且没有人真正知道它们是什么，

sentences.en: sort of handing them over like they were floral bouquets.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林的一家玩具店推出了一项店内促销活动，

sentences.en: Soon, Billy Possums were in toy stores from New York to San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 展出一只活的被捕获的负鼠，

sentences.en: Because real opossums weren't actually that common in cities then,
sentences.zh: 这样他们就可以向孩子们展示，

sentences.en: and no one really knew what they were,
sentences.zh: 好让孩子们熟悉这种即将成为他们最好朋友的新动物到底是什么样子的。

sentences.en: a toy store in Brooklyn ran an in-store promotion
sentences.zh: 我找到了该店的一则广告，上面写着：

sentences.en: with a live captive opossum
sentences.zh: 切莫让人说出

sentences.en: that they could show off to kids
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林的任何男人、女人或儿童

sentences.en: so that kids could familiarize themselves
sentences.zh: 没有见过那个可爱的小动物，

sentences.en: with what this new animal they were going to be best friends with was.
sentences.zh: 它的名字今天在世界各地被提及的次数

sentences.en: I found an advertisement for the store that read,
sentences.zh: 比任何其他动物都要多。

sentences.en: Do not let it be said
sentences.zh: 此前，报纸上曾出现过一些诗歌，

sentences.en: that any man, woman, or child in Brooklyn
sentences.zh: 某种程度上是在哀悼布娃娃的离去，

sentences.en: has not seen the cute little animal
sentences.zh: 以及这些泰迪熊进入儿童房并击败它们是多么令人难过。

sentences.en: whose name is mentioned more in all parts of the world today
sentences.zh: 而现在，报纸上开始出现关于

sentences.en: than any other.
sentences.zh: 比利负鼠取代泰迪熊的诗歌。

sentences.en: Previously, there had been poems in newspapers
sentences.zh: 但既然你可能从未听说过比利负鼠，

sentences.en: sort of mourning the passing of the dolls
sentences.zh: 你大概能猜到接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: and how sad it was that these teddy bears
sentences.zh: 这是一个彻头彻尾的失败，

sentences.en: were coming into nurseries and vanquishing them.
sentences.zh: 比利负鼠很快就被遗忘了，

sentences.en: And now there were poems in newspapers
sentences.zh: 在几个月内几乎从商店里消失殆尽。

sentences.en: about billy possums displacing teddy bears.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: But since you probably never heard of a billy possum,
sentences.zh: 比利负鼠甚至都没能撑到圣诞节，

sentences.en: you can guess what comes next.
sentences.zh: 这对于一个玩具来说算是一种特殊的悲剧。

sentences.en: It was a total flop,
sentences.zh: 对于比利负鼠为什么没有流行起来，

sentences.en: and the billy possum was forgotten
sentences.zh: 有几种可能的解释。

sentences.en: and almost entirely out of stores within a couple of months.
sentences.zh: 在几个月内几乎完全从商店里下架了。

sentences.en: So in other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: the billy possum never even made it to see Christmas time,
sentences.zh: 比利负鼠甚至没能撑到圣诞节，

sentences.en: which is a special kind of tragedy for a toy.
sentences.zh: 这对于一件玩具来说是一种特殊的悲剧。

sentences.en: There are several possible explanations
sentences.zh: 有几种可能的解释
